notes: POC goal: validate Dedicated capacity plan for low-latency conversational control in commercial robots
Primary asks: guaranteed throughput for 200-300 concurrent sessions, p95 end-to-end latency \u003c= 600ms for 64-token completions, ability to reserve capacity for seasonal peaks
Cost sensitivity: high — ops team wants predictable monthly committed spend vs variable hosted costs
Model preference: open-weight Llama-family variants (70B) with FP16/quantized runtime; willing to test Redwood-verified variants
Routing: prefer single-region (us-west) with failover to eu-west for backup; need automatic fallback to smaller quantized model under overload
Security: SSO + SAML mandatory, audit logs retained 12 months, encryption with customer-managed KMS
Quote from CTO: 'We can't absorb unpredictable tail latency — robots need firm SLOs or they will timeout.'
SE notes: observed KV cache hit variability across conversation lengths; batching config critical to hit p95 targets
Legal asks: data residency clause for certain customer datasets; NDA addendum in review
poc_plan: Phase 1 - Baseline: run 4-hour microbench of representative prompts on Hosted and small Dedicated cluster to baseline latency/throughput
Phase 2 - Throughput runs: scale to target concurrency (200-300 sessions) and measure sustained RPS, token throughput, and GPU util across configs
Phase 3 - Soak: 72-hour continuous run at 80% of target throughput to surface memory leaks, KV cache growth, and tail latency shifts
Phase 4 - Stress/failure modes: simulate region outage and model fallbacks, validate autoscaling and routing policies
Phase 5 - SLA draft & negotiation: convert observed numbers to contract SLAs (p50/p95/p99 targets, credits for violations)
Deliverable: benchmark report + recommended reserved GPU plan and optimization settings
representative_prompts: System: You are a concise assistant. User: Provide step-by-step diagnostics for a robot arm joint that reports intermittent jitter. Include likely causes and quick checks.
System: Summarize the last 10 minutes of telemetry and commands into 5 bullet root-causes for operator briefing.
System: Re-rank these 12 candidate assembly plans for energy efficiency and execution time; explain tradeoffs.
System: Given partial camera frame + LIDAR summary, predict likely obstacle classification and recommended evasive maneuver.
benchmark_results_summary: Baseline Dedicated (4x A100-equivalent) with quantized 70B model: sustained 180 concurrent sessions -> avg throughput 220 RPS (inference requests/sec); end-to-end p50 = 160ms for 32-token completions, p95 = 540ms for 64-token completions under 70% GPU util. Scaling to 8x A100-equivalents met target 300 concurrent sessions at p95 = 580ms (64-token). Observed queuing when concurrency exceeded 350; KV cache hit-rate improved after hot-prefix warmup (reduced tail by ~15%). Soak (72h) showed stable memory, but occasional 1-2% request error spikes tied to autoscaler cooldowns.
technical_summary: Model family: open Llama-family 70B quantized (int8/4), serving runtime: Redwood GPU-optimized engine with continuous batching + KV cache. Batching profile: target batch size 16 with dynamic batching up to 48 for throughput runs. Autoscaling policy: reserved 8-GPU pool + burst capacity to 12 GPUs. Fallback policy: route to 30B quantized variant when queueing > 200ms. Encryption: customer KMS + VPC-only control plane. Metrics collected: per-token latency, GPU util, queue length, KV cache hit rate, syscall traces for long-tail analysis.
